_comment: Conformance vectors for LME-03 token estimator and evidence-density scorer. Both the Swift leg (LongMemEvalTokenEfficiency.swift) and the Rust twin must produce identical results for every case. Token estimator: (utf8_byte_count + 3) / 4 (ceiling integer division). Evidence hit: normalized-substring match (lowercase, whitespace-collapsed).

token_estimator_cases.note: c=1, a=1, f=1, é=2 bytes = 5 bytes total: (5+3)/4 = 2

token_estimator_cases.input: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

evidence_hit_cases.payload_text: the meeting is on monday at 9am
evidence_hit_cases.note: Evidence uppercase, payload lowercase — normalized match

evidence_hit_cases.payload_text: reminder: the meeting is on monday at 9am in room 3
evidence_hit_cases.note: Evidence phrase embedded in larger payload
Multi-space in evidence collapses to single space → matches
Newlines in evidence normalized to spaces → matches
Empty evidence always returns false — no fact to match
Empty payload → evidence cannot appear in it
Both empty → evidence is empty → false
Evidence phrase order differs — substring match requires contiguous sequence

evidence_hit_cases.payload_text:
found 2 distilled factoid(s)
[1] drawer_id: abc123
    user prefers tea over coffee in the mornings
    confidence: 0.91 | sources: 2 | snr: 0.88
evidence_hit_cases.note: Evidence phrase found within moot_recall_distilled factoid output format (default: no query echo)

evidence_hit_cases.payload_text:
found 5 memory(s) matching: beverage preference
abc123  [benchmark/longmemeval]  user prefers tea over coffee in the morning.
def456  [benchmark/longmemeval]  likes green tea.
evidence_hit_cases.note: Evidence phrase found within moot_memory_search output format

evidence_hit_cases.payload_text:
found 2 distilled factoid(s)
[1] drawer_id: abc123
    user prefers tea over coffee in the mornings
    confidence: 0.91 | sources: 2 | snr: 0.88
evidence_hit_cases.note: Evidence has inverted order — 'coffee over tea' vs 'tea over coffee' → miss
